seo.title: Tangier Beach & Corniche | City Seafront | MoroccoTripMap
seo.description: Tangier’s city beach and corniche offer an easy sea-level break near hotels and the new town — walks, cafés and Atlantic-Mediterranean air.
seo.keywords: Tangier beach, Tangier corniche, Tangier seafront

name: Tangier Beach
hero_subtitle: City sand and corniche near the new town.

overview.title: Sea level after the medina climbs
overview.p1: Tangier’s main city beach stretches along the bay with a corniche for walking. It is not a remote cove — expect urban energy, hotels nearby and a practical place to breathe after medina lanes.
overview.p2: Swimming depends on conditions and local advice; many visitors come for the walk and the horizon toward Spain on clear days.

1.title: Open sand
1.desc: Cooler air and space to walk before the day heats up.

2.title: Active strip
2.desc: Hotels, walkers and sea breeze along the long front.

3.title: Promenade light
3.desc: Popular stroll time as the city turns toward the water.

food.title: Eat on the seafront
food.p1: Cafés and restaurants along the corniche — convenient, varied quality.
food.li2: Seafood options near the port end.
food.li5: Medina meals if you want more local kitchens.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Petit taxi or walk from the new town; hotels often sit on or near the strip.

2.title: Swimming
2.desc: Check local conditions; this is an urban beach, not a guarded resort bay.

3.title: Combine
3.desc: Good reset between medina mornings and evening plans.

q1.question: Is the beach clean enough to swim?
q1.answer: Conditions vary; many prefer walking and views. Ask locally on the day.

q2.question: How long is the seafront?
q2.answer: A long urban stretch — enough for a solid walk without leaving the city.

q3.question: Far from the medina?
q3.answer: A short taxi or a longer walk depending on your medina exit.

q4.question: Best time of day?
q4.answer: Morning for cooler air; evening for the promenade atmosphere.

q5.question: Family friendly?
q5.answer: Yes for walks and space; supervise near the water.
